name: AmountOfSubstancePerArea
label: Amount of Substance per Area
definition: An amount of substance, or of its equivalents, per unit area, such as an areal load or a deposition total in keq/ha or mmol m-2. QUDT 3.5.2 has no quantity kind with this dimension vector.

name: DirectionalVarianceSpectralDensity
label: Directional Variance Spectral Density
definition: The variance of a wave field per unit frequency and per unit direction, such as a directional energy density spectrum in m2 s rad-1; CF names it sea_surface_wave_directional_variance_spectral_density. QUDT 3.5.2's only quantity kind with this dimension vector is AreaTime.
